name: Blue Men of the Minch

attributes.attribute: body of water between the Hebrides
may descend from seals or be fallen angels
control the weather and the ship traffic

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The Blue Men of the Minch are Scottish folkloric figures. They are also called Fir Gorm and Fir Ghorma. The channel of the Minch divides the Hebrides. Blue-skinned beings haunt the coastal water. They may come from seals. They may be fallen angels. The Blue Men rule the weather of the channel. They rule the ships that cross it too.

okr.objective: Describe the Blue Men of the Minch, the blue beings of the channel.
key_results: The Blue Men of the Minch are Scottish figures.
They haunt the water between the Hebrides.
They may come from seals or from an angel race.
They rule the weather and the ships.
